title: Strategies to increase the robustness of microbial cell factories.
authors: Xu, Pei; Lin, Nuo-Qiao; Zhang, Zhi-Qian; Liu, Jian-Zhong
one_liner_zh: 该文综述微生物细胞工厂鲁棒性提升策略，虽提及转录因子和深度学习，但核心是工业菌株工程，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Engineering microbial cell factories have achieved much progress in producing fuels, natural products and bulk chemicals. However, in industrial fermentation, microbial cells often face various predictable and stochastic disturbances resulting from intermediate metabolites or end product toxicity, metabolic burden and harsh environment. These perturbances can potentially decrease productivity and titer. Therefore, strain robustness is essential to ensure reliable and sustainable production efficiency. In this review, the current strategies to improve host robustness were summarized, including knowledge-based engineering approaches, such as transcription factors, membrane/transporters and stress proteins, and the traditional adaptive laboratory evolution based on natural selection. Computation-assisted (e.g. GEMs, deep learning and machine learning) design of robust industrial hosts was also introduced. Furthermore, the challenges and future perspectives on engineering microbial host robustness are proposed to promote the development of green, efficient and sustainable biomanufacturers.
abstract_zh: 工程微生物细胞工厂在生产燃料、天然产物和大宗化学品方面已取得显著进展。然而，在工业发酵过程中，微生物细胞常面临由中间代谢物或终产物毒性、代谢负担及恶劣环境引起的各种可预测和随机性干扰。这些扰动可能降低生产效率和产量。因此，菌株的稳健性对于确保可靠且可持续的生产效率至关重要。本综述总结了当前提高宿主稳健性的策略，包括基于知识的工程方法，如转录因子、膜/转运蛋白和应激蛋白，以及基于自然选择的传统适应性实验室进化。同时，介绍了计算辅助（如基因组规模模型（GEMs）、深度学习和机器学习）设计稳健工业宿主的方法。此外，提出了工程微生物宿主稳健性面临的挑战和未来展望，以促进绿色、高效和可持续生物制造的发展。
